name: Side Arms: Triceps Press
summary: Kneeling side-on and tipped into a long side bend with the bottom hand on the shoulder rest, the top arm does an overhead triceps press.
steps: Kneel side-on at the footbar end of the carriage.
Bottom hand on the shoulder rest, body tipped over in one long diagonal.
Top hand holds a short loop, elbow bent, arm by the ear.
Breathe out to straighten the elbow; breathe in to bend.

layers.title: Top leg long
layers.text: Extend the outside leg in line with the body.

layers.title: Hover the knee
layers.text: Lift the outside knee just off the carriage.

layers.title: Leg pulses
layers.text: Add lifts or pulses with the long leg.

cautions.note: Supporting weight on one arm plus overhead load.
Make a fist on the shoulder rest.

cues:
Upper arm doesn't move.
Hips press forward — no folding at the hip.
Lift up out of the supporting shoulder.
Chest stays open to the side wall.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

aka: Triceps press in a side bend
